asr.full_text: hello gentlemen you are on the line dmitry askarov and in today's video I would like to talk about two topics, the first topic will go to the company qh w global I will speak in short to the company you want to make me mad you want no, this is your right, but I don do believe in this project and I don't want to continue to build it, my patience burst and my opinion is that payments will not be completed on the 17th It may take six months year, I do not know, but my opinion is that the payment is near we will not get. The faiths will pay us little, I am tired of waiting. This is as for the TH, so it is also global the second topic for which I wanted to talk about the company bit club network you all probably already heard about this company is engaged in biz keynotes company has been on the market more than two years principle for recommended this company it on, it has a good reputation and I have been a part of this project for a year and a half Michael Lievschitz, probably you already know what we do Richard Delyendorf, Alexey Baryshev, Andrej Rusanov and many more. Now I will not name everyone by names. We are working as a large, friendly team. I invite you to be our BitClub. Everyone of you is welcome! We will provide support to everyone. Let me add those people who join us and work with us, we will give you a limitless amount of contacts of those people who want to view your proposal offers and are interested in serious business a serious business project which will bring and improve not only your financial state but also the financial state of your family and your partners so only you should decide, I so that all the wants are accepted and you will find the contacts from me in my address you can contact me on skype phone us I will inform you more deeply about the bitcoin company network we will hold webinars discuss about the bitcoin network for growth of bitcoin in the market below are my links you can register and go to the Bit Club Network it's time to think about financial independence Dmitry Azkarov was with you, welcome to the Bit Club Network See you in Bit Club Company Good luck. Until new meetings

textual.observation: The speaker invites viewers to join BitClub Network and links participation in the project with improving the viewer's and family members' financial state.

evidence.quote: I Invite Everyone to Become Part of BitClub Network
I invite you to be our BitClub. Everyone of you is welcome! We will provide support to everyone.
a serious business project which will bring and improve not only your financial state but also the financial state of your family

textual.context: Promotional recruitment language from the speaker; the records do not establish whether the claimed financial improvement occurred or was guaranteed.
textual.potential_relevance: The requested action to join/work with BitClub Network is directly connected to a stated financial-improvement outcome for the viewer and family.
textual.limitations: No payment amount, timeframe, eligibility condition, transaction outcome, or independent verification of the project or financial claim is provided.

textual.observation: The speaker says people who join and work with BitClub will receive a limitless amount of contacts interested in viewing their proposals and serious business opportunities, and directs viewers to register.

evidence.quote: those people who join us and work with us, we will give you a limitless amount of contacts of those people who want to view your proposal offers and are interested in serious business
you can register and go to the Bit Club Network

textual.context: Promotional offer and audience-directed registration; the records do not clarify what information registration requires or how the contacts are obtained.
textual.potential_relevance: Joining or registering is linked to a claimed unlimited supply of business contacts, creating a conditional benefit relationship requiring later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the contacts are real, unlimited, qualified, or delivered, and do not show any registration fields, fees, or payment steps.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker expresses uncertainty and dissatisfaction about delayed payments concerning QH W Global, a separate company discussed before BitClub Network.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker directly recruits viewers into BitClub Network and presents participation as a serious business opportunity that can improve the viewer's and family's financial situation. He offers joining participants a large team and a supposedly limitless supply of interested contacts, then directs viewers to register through provided links, making the recruitment pathway central to the solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video promotes joining and working within a multi-person team, offers recruits access to contacts for further proposals, and links participation to improved finances. The observed mechanism is recruitment-based team expansion rather than a standalone product demonstration or ordinary purchase.
